svg.title: One tool result, two audiences: the model and a rendered view
svg.desc: The left column, outlined in terracotta, holds three things the server produces. A tools/list entry naming the tool world_clock and carrying a nested _meta.ui.resourceUri field. A resources/read result returning the document at ui://world-clock/app.html with MIME type text/html;profile=mcp-app. And a tools/call result whose resultType is complete, split into three bands: structuredContent, content and _meta. Two blue panels of identical width stand on the right. The upper one is the host-rendered sandboxed view, drawn as a small world clock widget listing two time zones with a Refresh control, fed by three arrows: what to render from the resourceUri field, the HTML from the resources/read result, and the data from structuredContent. The lower panel is the model context, fed by one arrow from the content array, and it states that the text block is the whole answer on a host that cannot render anything, so it has to be meaningful on its own, and that structuredContent never arrives there. The _meta band has no arrow at all, only a cross, because it reaches neither audience. A footer notes that resultType stays complete and the extension adds no new result shape, which is why a host that has never heard of it still works, and that a tool whose content block says see the widget is broken on every text-only host and useless to the model that called it.
svg.text: The model reads content. The view reads structuredContent. Neither reads _meta.
the view reads this. Never enters the model context.
the model reads this, and so does every text-only host
the view calls tools/call back through the host
This is the whole answer on a host
that cannot render anything, so it
has to be meaningful on its own.
resultType is "complete". The extension adds no new result shape, which is why a host that has never heard of it still works.
A tool whose content block says "see the widget" is broken on every text-only host, and useless to the model that called it.
